basic_info.description:
This modern one-bedroom is located in a relatively new condominium building in the heart of the popular Mission District. 

The building is composed of beautiful materials and superior finishes. The property features large windows, In-unit washer and dryer, Ample closet space, elevator access, Central Air Conditioning and Heating, designer appliances, custom millwork, meticulous finishes, and light-filled spaces. 

Premium details include white oak hardwood flooring, a custom walk-in closet, and a Latch keyless entry system. 

The building also features a shared rooftop deck that overlooks the city, offering residents a space to gather, complete with an outdoor grill, communal dining table, social seating, and lounge areas. 

It's all here at your fingertips. Call to book your showing today!

Key Features:
- Newer Luxury Building
- One Bedroom
- One Bathroom
- Bright and Light Filled Living Spaces
- Quiet
- Hardwood Flooring
- Modern Kitchen w/ Quartz Countertops
- Designer Stainless Steel Appliances
- Gas Range
- Dishwasher
- Garbage Disposal
- In-Unit Washer and Dryer
- Custom walk-in closet
- Central Air Conditioning and Heating
- Building Rooftop Patio/Deck w/ Downtown Views
- Rooftop BBQ/Cookout Facility
- Prime Mission Location @ Valencia and 23rd Streets
- One block from the 24th Street BART station. Easy access to MUNI and Tech shuttles, Valencia Street, Dolores Park, and Mission hot spots. Surrounded by popular restaurants, cafes, and nightlife.

Key Terms: 1 Year Lease, Security Deposit = 1.0x month rent, Water/ sewer and Garbage removal included, all other utilities and consumables extra, delivered unfurnished, Pet Negotiable - additional deposit required, No Smoking/Vaping/ Drugs/ Weed.

Building-specific move-in and move-out deposits and/or fees may be required.

Proof of employment, income, and a credit/background check are required as part of the application.

The unit is currently occupied, and some pictures are from a similar unit or digitally enhanced.
